### Etymology
#### Glyph
oracle bone script 刀
#### Sound
- *a priori:* ks=destruction, in=sharp (imitative of a sword being unsheathed or the blow of a sword)
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Man-made/ksi\|ksi]] (blade, knife)
